"Hello South Slope Management,

I’m writing regarding your December 30 email adding a $680 tenant repair charge for the 2025 sink-cabinet work.

The building repair insulated the riser, dried the cabinet cavity to 8–9% moisture (matching the 8% control), and installed a removable moisture-resistant back panel. The odor was resolved, testing remained dry, and the cabinet was returned to normal storage use. Management documented that the repair was at no charge to the household, so our household balance for this work is $0.

Please correct the ledger to remove the $680 charge and confirm the corrected $0 balance in writing.

Thank you,
Alex Valdez"
